laws.rule: Tokushima City bans dropping litter (drink containers, cigarette butts, chewing gum, paper) anywhere other than bins and ashtrays, and leaving dog droppings, on roads, rivers, parks and other public places across the whole city and on land that isn't yours. The ordinance sets a criminal fine of up to JPY 20,000 (about A$180.47, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). No street-smoking zone was found for Tokushima City.

layers.authority: Miyoshi City tourism, Iya Valley vine bridge (Iya no Kazurabashi)
layers.process: Crossing the Iya vine bridge costs JPY 550 for an adult (junior high school and older; about A$4.96) and JPY 350 for a primary school child (about A$3.16), at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82. Younger children are free. The bridge is open every day; the entrance closes at 17:00 from September to March, 18:00 from April to June, and 18:30 in July and August. It can close at short notice when a heavy-rain warning is issued, and it can't be crossed during the nightly lighting (19:00 to 21:30). No cap on numbers is listed.
